title: The Fall of Man

questions.question: Which creature tempted the woman in the garden?
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:1 (ESV): "Now the serpent was more crafty than any other beast of the field."

questions.question: What curse did God give to the serpent?
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:14 (ESV): "on your belly you shall go, and dust you shall eat."

questions.question: What did Adam and Eve do after eating the forbidden fruit?
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:8: They hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God.

questions.question: What did God use to make clothing for Adam and Eve?
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:21 (ESV): "the LORD God made for Adam and his wife garments of skins."

questions.question: What happened to Adam and Eve at the end of Genesis 3?
options: They were driven out of Eden
questions.correctAnswer: They were driven out of Eden
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:24: God drove out the man from the garden of Eden.

questions.question: What did Eve see about the forbidden tree that attracted her?
options: It was good for food and desirable for wisdom
questions.correctAnswer: It was good for food and desirable for wisdom
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:6: The tree was good for food, a delight to the eyes, and desired to make one wise.

questions.question: What did God place at the east of Eden to guard the tree of life?
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:24: God placed cherubim and a flaming sword to guard the way to the tree of life.

questions.question: What did the serpent tell Eve would happen if she ate the fruit?
options: She would become like the animals
She would become like God, knowing good and evil
questions.correctAnswer: She would become like God, knowing good and evil
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:5: The serpent said "you will be like God, knowing good and evil."

questions.question: What punishment did God give to the ground because of Adam?
options: It would be cursed and produce thorns
questions.correctAnswer: It would be cursed and produce thorns
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:17-18: The ground was cursed, bringing forth thorns and thistles.

questions.question: According to Genesis 3:16, what would increase for the woman?
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:16: "I will surely multiply your pain in childbearing."

questions.question: In Genesis 3:15, what is promised about the woman's offspring?
options: He would crush the serpent's head
questions.correctAnswer: He would crush the serpent's head
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:15 (ESV): "he shall bruise your head." This is the first messianic prophecy (protoevangelium).

questions.question: How did the serpent describe God's command about the tree?
options: "God knows you will be like angels"
"Did God actually say, You shall not eat of any tree?"
"God wants to keep you in darkness"
questions.correctAnswer: "Did God actually say, You shall not eat of any tree?"
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:1: The serpent twisted God's words to create doubt.

questions.question: What did Adam name his wife and why?
options: Woman, because she came from man
Eve, because she was the mother of all living
questions.correctAnswer: Eve, because she was the mother of all living
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:20: "The man called his wife's name Eve, because she was the mother of all living."

questions.question: What reason did God give for driving man out of the garden?
options: So he would not eat from the tree of life and live forever
questions.correctAnswer: So he would not eat from the tree of life and live forever
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:22: "lest he reach out his hand and take also of the tree of life and eat, and live forever."

questions.question: According to Genesis 3:19, what would happen to man because of his sin?
options: He would become like an animal
He would become invisible to God
questions.explanation: Genesis 3:19: "for you are dust, and to dust you shall return."

key_verse_text: 'I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring; he shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.'
